description: Fetch one Dutch public-procurement notice from TenderNed (Netherlands government tender platform) by its publication id, e.g. "433909". Returns the full shaped aanbesteding notice: title, buyer/opdrachtgever, complete description, notice type, procedure, legal framework, national/European scope, CPV codes with Dutch labels, NUTS region codes, keywords, award status (gegund), related publications, official PDF link, and the public TenderNed URL. Use the id from nl_tender_search or nl_tender_recent results.
name: nl_tender_detail
